stem.text: In the lungs, movement of dissolved carbon dioxide out of the capillaries occurs in one of two ways:

items: by diffusion through the endothelial cells of the capillaries
by leakage through pores in the endothelial cells of the capillaries.

stem.text: What is the **minimum** number of times that a carbon dioxide molecule that has been transported to the lungs in a red blood cell must cross a cell surface membrane to reach an air space in an alveolus?
